permissions.comment: The frontend listens for the window close request so it can flush unsaved notes before the window goes. Once it has, Tauri needs destroy to finish closing the window.

Lets the UI open a file or folder in VS Code via its vscode://file/<path> scheme, the same mechanism GitHub Desktop uses. Scoped to that one scheme: opener:default already covers http/https/mailto/tel, and nothing else should be launchable from the webview.
Show a file or folder selected in Explorer. Carries no path scope, so a mount under C:\Github works the same as one under the home folder.
Write-only clipboard for Copy path. Read stays ungranted; the app never needs to see the clipboard.
